## TEMP — delete once a render completes
GET the production URL of this webhook. It answers the whole jimp question in one call, without spending a credit or a Dezgo generation:

- `resolved` — did the **task runner** find jimp (the main process finding it proved nothing)
- `require_stack` — the directories actually searched, when it did not
- `node_path` / `allow_external` / `runners_mode` — what the container really has, or `env access blocked`
- `works` — decode + resize + re-encode for real, since resolving is not working
- `api` — v0 or v1, which the render node branches on
- `font_loads` — the branding path degrades silently without it

The Code node is set to **continue on error** and never throws, so the webhook always answers.

Unpublish and archive this once the render pipeline completes end to end.
